tool_args.rationale: A high-gradient measurement directly tests for the archived supercritical avalanche drop just above the observed gradient range; resolving that ambiguity is necessary before fitting a stationary smooth saturation law.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a smooth siphon saturation model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations show monotone concave saturation, but the maximum s_grad (2.44) is close to the archived avalanche threshold (~2.50–2.68), leaving the critical-threshold mechanism unidentified.
The rows vary input at one horizon and do not point to a trajectory-memory ODE; this costly batch is not the discriminating measurement.
It is irrelevant to the stated candidate mechanisms.
